text:
rachel: FYI hit a weird DX bug in the node onboarding sample: when LOG_LEVEL=debug and OTEL_AUTO_INSTRUMENT=true, retried requests after auth refresh lose X-Request-Id in logs.

emilio: can you share minimal repro steps and which example version?

rachel: examples/onboard/node v0.4.2. repro: start container with LOG_LEVEL=debug + OTEL_AUTO_INSTRUMENT=true, POST /generate with token that triggers 401 -> refresh -> retry. first attempt log: id=7c1d, retry log lacks id.

jyoti: are we setting the header in express middleware? or in outgoing SDK hook?

rachel: express middleware sets req.id and res.setHeader('X-Request-Id', req.id) before calling client.generate(). the refresh flow recreates the outgoing request and somehow the header isn't carried when auto-instrumentation is enabled.

ken: sounds like async context or header cloning issue with auto-instrumentation wrap. do we know the instrumentations affected?

emilio: earlier bugfix in auto-instrumentation 0.9.7 addressed header cloning on recreated requests. if sample pins 0.9.5 that would explain it.

ci-bot: opened onboard-samples PR #57 adding a linux-only integration test that simulates 401 -> refresh -> retry and asserts X-Request-Id present. CI: linux pass, mac flaky.

jyoti: add matrix variant with OTEL_AUTO_INSTRUMENT=false to catch behavior without instrumentation too.

rachel: added Dockerfile bump to auto-instrumentation >=0.9.7 in PR and a quickstart docs note: "If enabling OTEL_AUTO_INSTRUMENT, use auto-instrumentation >=0.9.7 to avoid X-Request-Id loss on auth retries."

ken: also backport the Dockerfile change to dedicated example images so new users don't hit this.

emilio: agreed. once CI green on linux I'll merge and cherry-pick to release branch.

rachel: resolved for onboarding samples, leaving thread open for any regression reports. thanks all :raised_hands:
